blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.
blocks.zh: 有效的视觉示意器必须保持图像忠贞性,同时产生下游传播模型能够有效学习的潜质. 先前的工作通过语义调整或联合发号施令-扩散培训,提高了潜在的可扩散性。 重新审视REPA-E是一种具有代表性的做法,我们发现,在消除其扩散目标和专注的基因区块的同时,保留从被腐蚀的潜在物中得出的语义预测,在相应的环境下会产生类似的下游生成性能。 这一观察激励了稳健预测的一般原则:与生成有关的信息应继续从被腐蚀的潜在物中取回。 我们以两个相辅相成的目标即时提出这一原则。 RobustAlign预测从被腐蚀的潜入物中预受训练的语义特征来保存高层次的结构,而RobustRecon重建了干净的图像来保留精细的空间和外观信息. 他们共同组成了强力对接与重建VAE(ROAR-VAE). 我们的分析表明,强力预测通过使有用的信息在高变异潜在方向上更容易获得,从而改进了易散性,而扩散模型往往会更早了解。 从经验上讲,RoAR-VAE的平均生成基准性能比同一培训预算下最强的基准活化剂提高2.19分,同时比FLUX.1-VAE提高小文本重建精度16.93分. 这些结果表明,ROAR-VAE在重建忠贞与下游遗传学之间实现了有利的平衡。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual tokenizers define the representation on which latent diffusion models learn to generate images ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . An effective tokenizer should preserve sufficient image information for faithful reconstruction, while organizing that information into a representation that a downstream diffusion model can learn efficiently. This latter property, often referred to as diffusability , can conflict with reconstruction fidelity: higher-capacity or weakly regularized latents may retain more visual detail yet be harder to model. Balancing reconstruction quality and diffusability is therefore a central challenge in visual tokenizer design.
blocks.zh: 视觉示意剂定义了潜在传播模型学习生成图像的表达方式(Rombach等,2022;Esser等,2024)。 一个有效的示意器应保存足够的图像信息,以便忠实地重建,同时将这些信息组织成一种表现方式,使下游传播模式能够有效地学习。 后一种财产通常被称为可扩散性(diffusable),它可能与重建忠诚相冲突:能力较强或规范化程度较弱的潜在物可能保留更可视性的细节,但难以建模。 因此,平衡重建质量和可扩散性是视觉装饰设计中的一个中心挑战。

blocks.en:
Recent work improves latent diffusability through semantic supervision during VAE training ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) or joint optimization of the tokenizer and diffusion model ( Heek et al., 2026 ; Duggal et al., 2026 ) .
A representative approach, REPA-E ( Leng et al., 2025a ) , combines both ideas: as shown in Fig. 2 (a), it jointly trains a VAE and a diffusion Transformer while aligning intermediate features with semantic targets from pretrained visual encoders ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ) .
However, only the semantic alignment objective directly updates the tokenizer encoder, while gradients from the diffusion objective are detached.
This raises a natural question: what actually drives the diffusability improvement in REPA-E, joint diffusion training or semantic supervision? To isolate these factors, we simplify REPA-E by removing the diffusion objective and its dedicated generative blocks while retaining prediction of pretrained visual features from corrupted latents, yielding RobustAlign (Figure 2 (b)).
Under a matched evaluation, the resulting tokenizer achieves comparable downstream generation performance to the tokenizer trained with REPA-E (Table 1 ), indicating that noisy semantic prediction alone can provide an effective learning signal for shaping a diffusion-friendly latent space.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作通过在VAE培训期间进行语义监督(Yao等人,2025年;Yao等人,2026年)或联合优化活化剂和传播模型(Heek等人,2026年;Duggal等人,2026年),提高了潜在的活性。
一种有代表性的方法,REPA-E(Leng等,2025年a)结合了两种观点:如图2(a)所示,它联合训练了一台VAE和一台扩散变形器,同时将中间特性与预先训练的视觉编码器的语义目标相配合(Yu等,2025年;Oquab等,2024年).
然而,只有语义对接目标直接更新了活化器编码器,而从扩散目标上得到的梯度被去除.
这就提出了一个自然的问题:什么是推动REPA-E的可扩散性改进、联合传播培训或语义监督? 为了孤立这些因素,我们简化了REPA-E,方法是去除扩散目标及其专用的基因区块,同时保留对腐败后潜质中预先受训练的视觉特征的预测,从而产生 " 强力 " (图2(b))。
根据相应的评价,由此产生的标注器实现了与经过REPA-E培训的标注器相类似的下游生成性能(表1),表明单是噪音语义预测就可以为塑造一个有利于扩散的潜在空间提供有效的学习信号.

blocks.en:
RobustAlign suggests a broader principle of robust prediction : generation-relevant information should remain predictable from heavily corrupted latents. By backpropagating this prediction objective through the corrupted latent, the tokenizer encoder is encouraged to organize target-relevant information so that it remains accessible under corruption. RobustAlign primarily supervises object-level structure and high-level visual content captured by pretrained features, but may underrepresent fine-grained spatial and appearance variations. We therefore introduce RobustRecon , which applies the same principle to the clean image itself, encouraging detailed image content to remain recoverable from corrupted latents.
Combining the two objectives yields Robust Alignment and Reconstruction (RoAR) (Figure 2 (c)). Both auxiliary objectives shape the encoder through corrupted latents, while the standard VAE reconstruction objective preserves faithful reconstruction from clean latents.
The latent PCA visualizations in Figure 3 further illustrate their complementary effects: RobustAlign emphasizes object-level organization and foreground–background separation, RobustRecon exposes richer local variation, and their combination exhibits both forms of structure.
blocks.zh:
强力协调提出了更宽泛的强力预测原则:与生成有关的信息应该能够从严重腐败的潜在物中预测。 通过腐败后的潜在手段来宣传这一预测目标,鼓励编码器整理与目标有关的信息,以便在其腐败下能够随时查阅。 robustAlign主要监督被预先训练过的地物所捕捉到的物体级结构和高水平的视觉内容,但可能代表了细纹的空间和外观变化. 因此,我们引入了“强力侦察”方案,该方案对干净的图像本身适用同样的原则,鼓励详细的图像内容继续从被腐蚀的潜伏物中恢复。
将这两个目标结合起来,就会产生强有力的调整和重建(图2(c))。 两个辅助目标都通过被腐蚀的潜入来塑造编码器,而标准VAE重建目标则保护忠实的重建不受清洁潜入的影响.
图3中潜在的五氯苯甲醚可视化进一步说明了它们的互补作用: RobustAlign强调对象级组织和前地-后地分离,RobustRecon揭示出更丰富的局部差异,它们的组合显示了两种结构形式。

blocks.en: We further ask: why does robust prediction improve diffusability? Under Gaussian corruption, higher-variance latent directions retain a higher signal-to-noise ratio and are therefore more robust to noise. Training the encoder to recover clean targets from corrupted latents consequently encourages generation-relevant information to remain accessible in these dominant directions, potentially by strengthening the principal modes or by enriching the image information they encode, as suggested by the PCA visualizations in Fig. 3 . Prior analyses further show that higher-variance covariance modes tend to be learned earlier by diffusion models ( Wang and Pehlevan, 2025 ) . Together, these observations suggest that robust prediction organizes useful information into prominent latent structure that can be acquired more readily by a downstream diffusion model.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步问:为什么强力预测能提高可扩散性? 在高斯腐败下,较高的变相潜入方向保持较高的信号与噪声比率,因此对噪声更强. 因此,通过培训编码器从被腐蚀的潜在物中取回干净目标,可以鼓励与生成有关的信息在这些主要方向上继续取用,如PPC可视化图3所建议,加强主要模式或丰富它们编码的图像信息。 先前的分析进一步表明,较高的相变模式往往通过传播模型(Wang和Pehlevan,2025年)更早地得到学习. 这些观测结果表明,可靠的预测将有用的信息组织到突出的潜在结构中,通过下游扩散模型可以更容易地获得。

blocks.en: Empirically, we train RoAR-VAE on ImageNet and evaluate reconstruction and downstream text-to-image generation, using a common diffusion backbone and dataset across tokenizers. RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and generative learnability (Fig. 1 ): it attains the best performance across three text-to-image benchmarks, with an average score 2.19 points above the strongest included baseline. At the same time, it maintains high-fidelity reconstruction, achieving 32.88 dB PSNR and 0.0349 LPIPS at 256 2 256^{2} resolution, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy over FLUX.1-VAE by 16.93 percentage points (Table 3 ). Ablations further show that RobustAlign and RobustRecon provide complementary gains, and that latent corruption is critical to downstream performance. These results support robust prediction as an effective principle for improving latent diffusability while retaining high reconstruction fidelity.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们在ImageNet上培训RoAR-VAE,并使用通用的传播主干线和数据集,对重建和下游的文本到图像生成进行评估。 RoAR-VAE在重建忠诚度和基因可学性之间实现了有利的平衡(图1):它实现了三个文本对图像基准的最佳表现,平均得分2.19分,高于最强的包括基线。 同时,它保持了高纯度重建,在256 2 256^{2}的分辨率上实现了32.88 dB PSNR和0.0349 LPIPS,同时将小文本重建精度比FLUX.1-VAE提高了16.93个百分点(表3. 腐败还表明,强势和强势竞争提供了互补的收益,潜在的腐败对下游的业绩至关重要。 这些成果支持强有力的预测,认为是改进潜在可扩散性的有效原则,同时保持高度的重建忠诚。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Latent diffusion separates perceptual compression from generative modeling ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , motivating visual tokenizers that balance reconstruction fidelity with downstream learnability ( Skorokhodov et al., 2025 ; Yue et al., 2026a ) .
Pre-trained visual representations ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) have improved latent diffusion through representation alignment in the denoiser ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) as well as regularization of the tokenizer ( Leng et al., 2025a ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . Recent work builds tokenizers directly on frozen pre-trained encoders ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , while subsequent approaches address the loss of fine-grained information when repurposing such encoders for generation ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yue et al., 2026b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . A complementary line of work jointly optimizes the tokenizer and diffusion model ( Vahdat et al., 2021 ; Heek et al., 2026 ; Duggal et al., 2026 ; Leng et al., 2025a ) to better align latent representations with generative learning.
Other approaches improve tokenizer representations through equivariance and perturbation-based regularization ( Kouzelis et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Overview. Our goal is to learn a VAE latent space that supports both faithful reconstruction and efficient downstream diffusion learning.
We begin by revisiting REPA-E (§ 3.1 ) and isolate the supervision that directly shapes the tokenizer encoder.
This leads to RobustAlign (§ 3.2 ), which predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents without jointly training a full diffusion model.
We then introduce RobustRecon (§ 3.3 ), which instead reconstructs the clean image from corrupted latents to preserve fine-grained spatial and appearance details that semantic features may underrepresent. Combining the two objectives yields RoAR-VAE . Finally, we discuss a possible explanation for the diffusability gains by making semantic and spatial information more accessible in dominant latent modes (§ 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
概览. 我们的目标是学习一个支持忠实重建和高效下游传播学习的VAE潜在空间。
我们首先重新审视REPA-E(§ 3.1),并隔离直接塑造活化剂编码器的监督.
这导致了RobustAlign(§3.2),该词预测了从被腐蚀的潜在物中预受训练的语义特征,而没有共同训练出一个完整的传播模型.
然后,我们引入了RobustRecon(第3.3节),它从腐败的潜想中重建了干净的图像,以保存精细的空间和外观细节,语义特征可能不代表这些细节。 将这两个目标结合起来,就能产生ROAR-VAE。 最后,我们讨论一种可能的解释,通过使语义和空间信息在主要潜在模式中更容易获得,从而提高可扩散性(第3.4节)。

blocks.en:
A key detail of REPA-E is that the flow-matching loss does not backpropagate through the VAE encoder, as such gradients were found to cause latent variance collapse ( Leng et al., 2025a ) .
Specifically, the latent input to ℒ FM \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}} is gradient-detached, whereas ℒ REPA \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{REPA}} remains differentiable through 𝒛 t \bm{z}_{t} to the encoder. Consequently, among the two diffusion-side objectives, only ℒ REPA \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{REPA}} provides additional supervision to the VAE encoder.

blocks.en: RobustAlign encourages semantically organized latent representations, but semantic targets may underrepresent fine-grained spatial and appearance details that are also important for downstream generation. As illustrated in Fig. 3 (c), RobustAlign produces coherent object-level structure, yet local variations within an object, such as texture and boundaries, are less prominent. This motivates a complementary objective that encourages detailed image information to remain recoverable from corrupted latents.
blocks.zh: 强力表示力鼓励有组织的潜在表示力,但语义目标可能不足以代表精细的空间和外观细节,而这些细节对下游一代来说也很重要. 如图3(c)所示,RobustAlign生成了连贯的对象级结构,然而一个物体内的局部变化,例如纹理和边界,则不太突出. 这激励了一个相辅相成的目标,鼓励详细的图像信息能够从被腐蚀的潜在物中取回。

G ξ G_{\xi} shares the architecture of the VAE decoder but uses independent parameters and is discarded after tokenizer training. Beyond standard posterior sampling in VAEs ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) , RobustRecon applies corruption over a broad range of noise levels, including latents with very low signal-to-noise ratios. The resulting objective backpropagates through 𝒛 t \bm{z}_{t} to the encoder, encouraging fine-grained image information to remain accessible under corruption. As shown in Fig. 3 (d), RobustRecon exposes richer local spatial and appearance variations than RobustAlign, although its object-level foreground–background organization is less pronounced.

blocks.en: Downstream generative modeling. To evaluate latent diffusability, we freeze each tokenizer and train the same text-conditioned diffusion Transformer from scratch on a filtered and recaptioned LAION dataset ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) at 256 2 256^{2} resolution. We use an MMDiT backbone ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) with 24 layers, a hidden dimension of 1024, and approximately 0.8B parameters, together with a frozen Qwen3-0.6B text encoder ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . For tokenizers with different downsampling factors, we adjust the patch size to keep the diffusion sequence length fixed.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Reconstruction versus diffusion learnability. Table 2 compares RoAR-VAE with existing visual tokenizers in terms of reconstruction quality and downstream generation under a fixed 32k-step training budget. RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between the two objectives, substantially improving reconstruction while maintaining strong downstream learnability. Compared with the reconstruction-oriented FLUX.1-VAE, RoAR-VAE improves PSNR by 1.80 dB and reduces LPIPS from 0.0510 to 0.0349, while outperforming the strongest competing learnability-enhanced tokenizer by 2.19 points on the average downstream benchmark score. RoAR-VAE also approaches the reconstruction and generation performance of FLUX.2-VAE, a strong industrial tokenizer with a similarly balanced reconstruction–generation trade-off.
blocks.zh: 重建与传播的可学习性。 表2将ROAR-VAE与现有的可视化活化剂相比,在32k级固定培训预算下,在重建质量和下游一代方面。 RoAR-VAE在两个目标之间实现了有利的平衡,大幅度地改进了重建,同时保持了强大的下游可学习性. 相较于以重建为主的FLUX.1-VAE,ROAR-VAE将PSNR改进了1.80 dB,将LPIPS从0.0510降至0.0349,同时在下游平均基准分上比起最强的相竞可学习性增强的标分器2.19分. RoAR-VAE还处理FLUX.2-VAE的重建和生产业绩,FLUX.2-VAE是一种具有类似平衡的重建-生产取舍的强有力的工业代号。

blocks.en: Generated image quality. Figure 4 qualitatively compares downstream generation across different tokenizers. RoAR-VAE produces clearer object shapes and finer visual structure, including more distinct animal contours, sharper suitcase and bag textures, and more regular soccer-ball patterns. Compared with the reconstruction-driven FLUX.1-VAE, these results indicate faster acquisition of object appearance and structure under the same downstream training budget. VA-VAE also exhibits strong learnability, but its generations are noticeably smoother and contain fewer details, consistent with its weaker reconstruction performance relative to RoAR-VAE.

blocks.en: Fine-grained reconstruction. Table 3 further evaluates preservation of challenging text and facial details. RoAR-VAE achieves the best performance across all reported text and face reconstruction metrics. Despite being trained from scratch solely on ImageNet, it improves small-text accuracy over FLUX.1-VAE by 16.93 percentage points and increases small-face similarity from 0.53 to 0.65. Although VA-VAE, VTP, and PAE achieve competitive generation scores in Table 2 , their weaker text and face reconstruction results reveal a substantial loss of fine-grained information. Figure 5 provides qualitative examples of these differences, highlighting distortions in textual and facial patterns introduced by the compared tokenizers.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present RoAR-VAE, a visual tokenizer built on the principle of robust prediction . By revisiting and simplifying REPA-E, we identify prediction of clean targets from corrupted latents as an effective source of supervision for shaping diffusion-friendly representations.
We realize this principle with RobustAlign for semantic structure and RobustRecon for fine-grained spatial and appearance details.
Our analysis suggests that robust prediction encourages generation-relevant information to remain accessible in prominent latent modes that are more resistant to corruption and tend to be learned earlier by downstream diffusion models. Empirically, the two objectives provide complementary gains, allowing RoAR-VAE to improve downstream generative learnability while maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction. These results highlight robust prediction as a simple and effective principle for designing visual tokenizers that better balance reconstruction and generation.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍RoAR-VAE,这是一个基于强力预测原则的视觉示意器。 通过重新审视和简化《欧洲区域环境保护法》,我们确定对腐败潜伏物的清洁目标的预测是形成有利于传播的表述的有效监督来源。
我们意识到了这个原则,用RobustAlign来表示语义结构,用RobustRecon来表示精细的空间和外观细节。
我们的分析表明,稳健的预测鼓励以较能抵御腐败的突出潜在模式提供与生成有关的信息,并往往通过下游传播模式更早地了解这些信息。 从经验上讲,这两个目标提供了互补的收益,使RoAR-VAE能够改善下游的基因可学习性,同时保持高诚信度重建. 这些结果突出表明,强力预测是设计视觉示意器以更好地平衡重建和发电的简单而有效的原则。

blocks.en: A.1 Tokenizer Training
blocks.zh: A.1 助推器培训

blocks.en: RoAR-VAE uses the standard convolutional autoencoder architecture adopted by latent diffusion models ( Esser et al., 2021 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) , with an 8 × 8\times spatial downsampling factor, 32 latent channels, and approximately 84M parameters. The encoder and decoder each contain four resolution stages with channel widths ( 128,256,512,512 ) (128,256,512,512) and two residual blocks per stage. All tokenizer training is performed on ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution.
blocks.zh: RoAR-VAE采用了由潜在扩散模型(Esser等,2021;Rombach等,2022.)采用的标准相旋自编码器架构,其空间下取样因子为8×8等,潜入通道为32等,参数约为84M等. 编码器和解码器各有四个分辨率相间,通道宽度为128,256,512,512(128,256,512,512),每个相间有2个残块. 在ImageNet(Deng等人,2009年)上以256×256256\times 256分辨率进行了所有标致器培训。

blocks.en: Training proceeds in two stages. We first warm up the tokenizer for 200k optimization steps using the standard VAE objective ℒ VAE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VAE}} . The reconstruction objective uses unit weights for the L1 and LPIPS losses, together with a KL regularization weight of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . Adversarial supervision is provided by a DINOv2-S ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) -based discriminator. We then refine the tokenizer for an additional 250k steps using the RoAR objectives with λ A = 1.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{A}}=1.5 and λ R = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{R}}=0.5 . The corruption level is sampled uniformly as t ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) t\sim\mathcal{U}(0,1) .

We use features from a frozen DINOv2-B ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) encoder as the semantic prediction target. For RobustRecon, the pixel predictor G ξ G_{\xi} is initialized from the VAE decoder D ψ D_{\psi} obtained after the warm-up stage and predicts the clean image from corrupted latents using L1 and LPIPS losses.

blocks.en: A.2 Downstream Generative Modeling
blocks.zh: A.2 下游基因模型

blocks.en:
For each tokenizer, we freeze its parameters and train a text-conditioned diffusion Transformer from scratch on a filtered and recaptioned version of LAION ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . All downstream models are trained at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution with a global batch size of 1,024. The diffusion backbone is an MMDiT ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) with 24 Transformer layers, a hidden dimension of 1,024, 16 attention heads, and approximately 0.8B parameters. Text conditioning is provided by a frozen Qwen3-0.6B encoder ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Because the compared tokenizers use different spatial compression factors, we adjust the latent patch size to maintain the same sequence length for the diffusion Transformer. Specifically, we use a 1 × 1 1\times 1 latent patch size for tokenizers with a downsampling factor of 16 and a 2 × 2 2\times 2 patch size for tokenizers with a downsampling factor of 8. This keeps the number of latent tokens processed by the downstream model consistent across tokenizer variants.
blocks.zh:
对于每个标定器,我们冻结其参数,并在LAION(Shuhmann等,2022年)被过滤并被取回的版本上从头开始训练有文字条件的传播变形器。 所有下游型号均以256×256256\times 256分辨率进行训练,全球分批规模为1,024. 扩散主干是一款MMDIT(Esser等,2024;Chen等,2026b),有24个变形器层,隐藏维度为1,024,16个注意力头,大约为0.8B参数. 文本调制由被冻结的Qwen3-0.6B编码器提供(Yang等,2025.).
因为比较的活化器使用不同的空间压缩因子,所以我们调整了潜在的补丁大小,为扩散变形器保持相同的序列长度. 具体来说,我们使用1×1 1\times 1潜伏的补丁大小来表示活化剂,降标系数为16;使用2×2 2\times 2 补丁大小来表示活化剂,降标系数为8。 这使得由下游模型处理的潜在代币数量在各种代币变体之间保持一致。

blocks.en: For RoAR-VAE, diffusion timesteps are sampled using shifted logit-normal sampling with exponential shifting and μ = 1.5 \mu=1.5 . For each baseline tokenizer, we use its official or recommended timestep scheduler. All downstream models are optimized with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , using β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and a caption dropout probability of 0.1. At inference time, we use an Euler sampler with 50 sampling steps and a classifier-free guidance weight of 5.0.
blocks.zh: 对RoAR-VAE来说,传播时间步骤是采用转动的对数正常取样方式进行抽样的,其指数变化和μ=1.5\mu=1.5。 每个基准标定器,我们使用其官方或推荐的时序调度器。 所有下游模型均由AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019)进行优化,使用β 1 = 0.9\βa_{1}=0.9,β 2 = 0.999\βa_{2}=0.999,持续学习率为2×10−4 2.\times 10^{-4}字幕的退学概率为0.1. 推想时,我们使用一个Euler取样器,有50个取样步骤,无分级制导重量为5.0.

blocks.en: A.3 Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: A.3 评价细节

blocks.en: SD3-VAE ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and FLUX.1-VAE ( Labs, 2024 ) serve as reconstruction-oriented baselines from large-scale text-to-image systems. VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) directly aligns latent representations with pretrained visual features using a margin-based similarity objective, while VTP ( Yao et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes reconstruction and visual representation learning. PAE ( Yue et al., 2026b ) builds on pretrained visual encoders and regularizes the latent manifold for improved downstream generation. REPA-E-FLUX ( Leng et al., 2025b ) jointly refines the tokenizer and diffusion model through representation alignment; in our evaluation, we use only the resulting tokenizer and retrain the downstream diffusion model from scratch. We additionally include FLUX.2-VAE ( Labs, 2025 ) as a strong reference, since its tokenizer training data and recipe are undisclosed.
blocks.zh: SD3-VAE(Esser等,2024年)和FLUX.1-VAE(Labs,2024年)作为从大规模文本到图像系统的以重建为导向的基线. VA-VAE(Yao等,2025年)利用比值相似性目标,直接将潜伏的表征与预受训练的视觉特征相配合,而VTP(Yao等,2026年)联合优化了重建和视觉表现学习. 太平洋建筑工程师有限公司(Yue等人,2026年b)以预先训练的视觉编码器为基础,使潜在的多面体规范化,以改善下游的一代。 REPA-E-FLUX(Leng等,2025年b)通过表示对等,共同完善了标注剂和传播模型;在我们的评价中,我们只使用由此产生的标注剂,从零开始对下游扩散模型进行再培训. 此外,我们还将FLUX.2-VAE(实验室,2025年)作为有力的参考,因为其象征性培训数据和食谱尚未公布。

blocks.en: We evaluate reconstruction on the ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) validation set at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution and report reconstruction FID (rFID), PSNR, LPIPS, and SSIM. To further assess preservation of fine-grained content, we evaluate on TokBench ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , which contains challenging text- and face-centric images. For text reconstruction, TokBench reports exact recognition accuracy (T-ACC) and normalized edit distance (T-NED), with separate metrics for small text instances and all text instances. For face reconstruction, it measures cosine similarity between face-recognition embeddings (F-Sim), likewise reporting both small-face and overall results. These metrics complement standard image-level reconstruction measures by directly evaluating whether tokenizers preserve small, semantically important details.
blocks.zh: 我们通过ImageNet(Deng et al.,2009年)验证确定256×256256\times256分辨率,并报告重建情况。 为了进一步评估精细内容的保存情况,我们对Tok Bench(Wu等,2025年)进行了评估,其中载有具有挑战性的文字和以面相为中心的图像。 对于文本重建,Tok Bench报告精确的识别精确度(T-ACC)和规范化的编辑距离(T-NED),对小文本实例和所有文本实例分别设置了参数. 对于面相重建,它测量面相识别嵌入物(F-Sim)的同分性,同样报告小面相和总体结果。 这些度量衡通过直接评价标点剂是否保存了小型的,具有高度重要性的细节来补充标准图像级重建措施.

blocks.en: For each tokenizer, we train a downstream diffusion model following Appendix A.2 . Unless otherwise stated, benchmark results are measured after 32k downstream optimization steps, enabling comparison of latent diffusability under a fixed training budget. We evaluate text–image alignment on three complementary benchmarks. GenEval ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) evaluates compositional generation involving object co-occurrence, spatial relations, counting, and colors, while GenEval2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) extends this setting with broader coverage of visual concepts and higher compositionality. DPG-Bench ( Hu et al., 2024 ) focuses on dense prompts containing multiple objects, detailed attributes, and complex relationships. Each reported score is averaged over four independent sampling seeds. We additionally report the arithmetic mean of the three benchmark scores, denoted Avg. , as a compact summary.
blocks.zh: 每个标注剂,我们按照附录A.2训练下游扩散模型。 除非另有说明,基准结果在32克下游优化步骤后加以衡量,从而能够在固定的培训预算中对潜在的可扩散性进行比较。 我们评价三个互补基准的文本-图像一致性。 常规 Eval(Ghosh等,2023年)评价涉及物体共聚、空间关系、计数和颜色的组分生成,而GenEval2(Kamath等,2025年)则扩大这种环境,扩大视觉概念的涵盖范围并增加组分。 DPG-Bench (Hu等, 2024) 专注于包含多个对象,详细属性,和复杂关系的密集导出. 每个报告的分数平均取自4个独立的取样种子。 我们还将三个基准分数的算术平均值(Avg.)作为简明摘要加以报告。
